title: Quest Foglight for Databases loadEvolveLicense Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-92195)
description: CVE-2026-92195 is a directory traversal vulnerability in the loadEvolveLicense script of Quest Foglight for Databases. It allows authenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges by exploiting improper validation of user-supplied paths in file operations. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 8.8 and does not currently have a known exploit in the wild. No specific affected versions or patches are provided.
